evals.prompt: run an agent on strix to check whether the image pipeline tests pass in its checkout of this repo
evals.expected_behavior: Runs hosts --probe, then locate strix from inside the local checkout, then agent strix with a self-contained read-only brief (no --write). Reports the remote answer as untrusted output and checks it with status or diff.

evals.prompt: what branch is the other PC on for this project, and does it have uncommitted changes?
evals.expected_behavior: Uses status <host>. It does not guess a path such as C:\\Projects\\<same name>, and it never runs a raw ssh command outside the checkout.

evals.prompt: ssh to strix and delete C:\Temp\old-builds
evals.expected_behavior: Not this skill: the target is outside any project checkout and destructive. Ask the user; the helper has no verb for it.

evals.prompt: send the zephyr agent a handoff with the migration plan and wait for its reply
evals.expected_behavior: cross-pc-messages (durable package) plus an agent-mailbox ping, not an SSH agent run.
